objective: Extract state-conditioned spatial background that is demonstrably predictable; let conditional Flow Matching model action-dependent and unexplained remaining increments.
distinction: Energy concentration in low frequencies is neither necessary nor sufficient for conditional predictability. High graph frequency is not synonymous with stochasticity.

existing_implementation.background: State-only prior, complete state input, soft output resolvent (I + tau L_sym)^-1.
existing_implementation.fm: Action-conditioned transport from Z_t + stop_gradient(background) + source noise to the transition endpoint.
existing_implementation.prior_training: Independent filtered-increment MSE; action branch omitted and FM paths detached from the background increment.
existing_implementation.unresolved: Fixed tau=10 and supervision in filtered latent coordinates are not validated by complete retraining or physical traffic improvements.

graph_contract.nodes: Traffic road semantics fixed by topology and vehicle class, not validation activity.
graph_contract.edges: Actual legal passenger lane connections already provided by traffic/topology.py; preserve directed messages.
graph_contract.spectral_operator: Explicit symmetric normalized Laplacian of the traffic adjacency for graph-frequency analysis.
graph_contract.disconnected_components: Retain components and complete repeated eigenspaces; do not select arbitrary directions within a large nullspace.
graph_contract.isolated_traffic_nodes: Use an explicit local prediction path; do not label isolation as evidence of a traffic-wide smooth mode.
graph_contract.activity_mask: The existing training-active induced graph is a sensitivity analysis, not an automatically justified production graph.

proposed_background.input: Full current traffic latent state and, in a later matched-capacity experiment, causally available past state history; no current or future routing actions.
proposed_background.reconstruction: B0 + B1 + B2 = I, so the decomposition discards no graph modes.
proposed_background.background_form: b_phi(Z,H) = sum_k g_k B_k f_phi,k(Z,H), with complete inputs and state-only gates.
proposed_background.gate_policy: Do not force higher-frequency gates to zero. Compare a complete state-mean predictor with multiscale heads before claiming a spectral benefit. Gates and scales must be selected on training/inner validation only.
proposed_background.scale_status: 1 and 10 illustrate a complete smooth bank, not validated optimal scales.
proposed_background.supervision: Supervise predictable means while checking decoded count and speed errors, occupied-road errors and total-count errors. Keep background and FM endpoint definitions aligned.
proposed_background.loss_caveat: Soft bands overlap and are not orthogonal. The sum of squared band errors is not the full-state squared error.

residual_transport.condition: Full allowed state/history and routing conditions; no additional future information for the actor.
residual_transport.frequency_support: FM residual can contain any frequency, including low-frequency action effects and background prediction errors.
residual_transport.source_noise: Keep original noise coordinates and scale for the first controlled comparison; changing noise is a separate intervention.
residual_transport.gradient_contract: FM loss must not move the background predictor through source/reference paths. Background is trained with its own objective.
residual_transport.current_equivalence: The existing absolute-state path is a translated residual path; conceptual residualization alone is not a new experimental improvement.

predictability_screen.checkpoint: Completed 49,636-update Ingolstadt pretraining checkpoint; no undertrained replacement.
predictability_screen.fixed_selection: Existing 768 training and 384 development-validation windows, disjoint demand groups.
predictability_screen.latent_forecast: Saved fully solved unfiltered state-only frozen-body output head.
predictability_screen.physical_forecast: One 65x2 train-only ridge head for actual raw next-minus-current count/speed increments; shared across all frequencies.
predictability_screen.baselines: Zero increment and per-road training mean increment.
predictability_screen.skill: 1 - pooled held-out band prediction SSE / pooled baseline band SSE; undefined if baseline energy is zero.
predictability_screen.uncertainty: 2000 whole demand-group resamples; descriptive intervals, not proof after selecting favorable bands.
predictability_screen.interpretation: Positive skill is an initial indication of predictable structure under this probe. A negative result does not rule out a newly trained predictor with richer state history.
forbidden_claims: Causal zero-action traffic evolution identified from behavior replay
Soft prior plus FM already beats regression
Frozen-body development skill proves downstream policy improvement

subsequent_validation: Use a new split or nested validation to choose frequency allocation and strength.
Retrain matched-budget state-only deterministic, Gaussian, FM-only and background-plus-FM variants sufficiently.
Check full and decoded prediction errors, residual conditional means/dispersion, CRPS or Energy Score, coverage and multistep statistics.
Evaluate matched-action ranking/regret and real SUMO routing cost under equal real-interaction budgets.

protocol.bootstrap: 2000 whole demand-group resamples; pooled sums; same resample seed
protocol.joint_scaling: each physical channel divided by its train-only global increment RMS; no centering
limits: frozen old action-conditioned body with condition removed
one-step linear-head probe; not fully retrained soft/FМ model
state-only prediction is not a causal zero-action background
Ingolstadt SUMO replay, not sensor traffic
protocol.physical_head: train-only F64 ridge, 65x2, relative lambda 1e-6; frozen same state-only front
protocol.state_inputs: current flow encoding, native state/downstream/upstream branches; condition branch omitted
protocol.targets: raw actual adjacent 30-second endpoint increments; births included; no speed interval averaging

completed_screen.finding: Under this frozen state-only front, predictable state-dependent physical background exists, but lowest graph frequencies do not isolate it. Low-band speed is predictable while low-band count is poor; medium/high bands also have stable positive skill. This does not establish benefit of a learned frequency allocation or FM residual over deterministic prediction.
completed_screen.root_verification: All 24 space-band pooled scores independently reconstructed from group CSV; 79 combined focused tests passed in 7.57 seconds.

filter_bank_algebra_verification.conclusion: Complete gain reconstruction error 1.11e-16 on the 853-road eigensystem; construction is verified, model effectiveness is not.
